== Rulings version placement, 6 November 2026 ==

=== Build notes ===
* The Players Committee card-data entry is the unique •Beru Stew, GEMP ID <code>1_72</code>. Its three rulings belong with [[Beru Stew (Errata)]], while the printed <code>1_72o</code> article [[Beru Stew]] links to that section.<ref name="pc-card-data">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json], Players Committee, •Beru Stew (GEMP ID 1_72, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183258/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026).</ref>
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Before this ruling addition, [[Special:PermanentLink/169211|Beru Stew revision 169211]] described the page as the printed Decipher face with <code>card_uid=1_72o</code>, but also had <code>uniqueness=Unique</code> and <code>version_label=Decipher final (Glossary 1998)</code>. Its existing text attributes the unique-title revision to [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998)]]. [[Special:PermanentLink/169212|The errata article, revision 169212]], separately has <code>1_72</code> and the same uniqueness value. These pre-existing metadata fields were left unchanged; the PC card-data rulings were not used to resolve the printed-face identity.
